description: Baseline benchmark setup crashed during self startup subprocess

asi.hypothesis: Establish baseline for usecli startup/config/command discovery including self and dependency scenarios.
asi.rollback_reason: Benchmark script failed before baseline due to subprocess error; need inspect stderr and adjust benchmark setup rather than code optimization.
asi.next_action_hint: Run the self_code subprocess manually with stderr visible; likely Python 3.14/Typer compatibility or dependency mismatch in local environment.

description: Baseline benchmark after using project uv environment for dependencies

asi.hypothesis: Measure representative CLI startup with dependencies available via uv run; this establishes baseline for config and command discovery speed.
asi.benchmark_note: Previous crash was benchmark environment only: plain python lacked simple-term-menu; measure.sh now launches outer harness through uv run python.

description: Lazy console-script alias discovery during config matching

asi.hypothesis: Avoid importlib.metadata.distributions() on the common path where config command_name exactly matches argv[0]; only compute aliases for mismatched configs that might be valid aliases.
asi.result: Small improvement across all startup scenarios; preserves alias behavior by lazily falling back to metadata lookup only when needed.

description: Cache get_config by unchanged cwd to avoid repeated root detection

asi.hypothesis: Repeated get_config calls during one process can skip find_project_root when cwd is unchanged.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary startup_ms was slightly worse than best despite large self_ms improvement; dependency/config medians dominate the primary benchmark and did not improve.
asi.next_action_hint: Reconsider with a primary metric that weights self startup, or combine this cache with changes that reduce dependency/config paths before retesting.

description: Iterate module __dict__ instead of inspect.getmembers for command class discovery

asi.hypothesis: Avoid sorting and tuple creation from inspect.getmembers while loading many command modules.
asi.rollback_reason: Focused tests patch inspect.getmembers with MagicMock modules; direct __dict__ iteration encountered MagicMock sentinel values and failed test assumptions. Primary also did not improve.
asi.next_action_hint: If revisiting, guard with `vars(module)` only for real ModuleType and fallback to inspect.getmembers for non-module mocks, or update tests intentionally if behavior change is desired.

description: Fast __dict__ command member iteration for real modules with test fallback

asi.hypothesis: Use module.__dict__.values for real imported command modules to avoid inspect.getmembers sorting overhead, while retaining inspect fallback for mocked tests.
asi.rollback_reason: Checks passed but primary startup_ms regressed; overhead is not important relative to subprocess/import/config costs or variance.
asi.next_action_hint: Focus on config discovery/import-time dependency costs instead of command class member enumeration.

description: Cache parsed pyproject data inside ConfigManager

asi.hypothesis: Avoid parsing pyproject.toml twice during startup for version and direct-dependency checks.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary startup_ms regressed; pyproject parsing is not a measurable bottleneck in this workload or added method overhead offsets savings.
asi.next_action_hint: Look for import-time heavy modules or avoid unnecessary recursive config scans rather than pyproject parse caching.

description: Lazy usecli.cli.core package exports to reduce eager Rich/validator imports

asi.hypothesis: Parent package usecli.cli.core is imported before base_command, so removing eager imports of error handlers, validators, and UI aliases should reduce startup import cost.
asi.rollback_reason: Benchmark crashed during self startup; stderr not included in benchmark output, so the compatibility issue needs manual reproduction after revert if revisited.
asi.next_action_hint: Reapply cautiously and run `PYTHONPATH=src uv run python -c 'import sys; sys.argv=["usecli"]; import usecli'` with stderr visible. Likely some code imports deprecated aliases such as usecli.cli.core.ui/list/title through package init.

description: Lazy import terminal_menu inside Menu methods

asi.hypothesis: Avoid importing simple-term-menu during normal CLI startup unless Menu is actually used interactively.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary startup_ms regressed; simple-term-menu import is not dominant in current uv environment or saved work is hidden by other import costs/noise.
asi.next_action_hint: Larger import-time wins likely require reducing core package/Rich/Jinja imports or avoiding loading hidden init/make commands, not just menu utility laziness.

description: Skip usecli-only init command import for downstream CLIs

asi.hypothesis: Downstream CLIs should not import/register `init_command.py`, which is only visible for the `usecli` executable and pulls heavy scaffolding dependencies like Jinja/Rich prompts/pyfiglet.
asi.result: Substantial dependency startup win while preserving self usecli behavior and focused tests; avoids loading a hidden command instead of changing discovery semantics.

description: Skip usecli-only make command modules for downstream CLIs

asi.hypothesis: `make:command` and `make:theme` are visible only for the `usecli` executable but are still imported by downstream CLIs, pulling Jinja/caseconverter/Rich scaffolding dependencies.
asi.result: Large dependency/config startup improvement by avoiding hidden usecli-only command module imports for non-usecli argv[0]; self usecli still loads them.

description: Hoist usecli-only command-name check out of command file loop

asi.hypothesis: Avoid recomputing Path(sys.argv[0]).name for every discovered command file.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary startup_ms regressed versus best; micro-optimization is lost in noise and may not affect real file/import bottlenecks.
asi.next_action_hint: Focus on reducing modules imported, not per-file condition overhead.

description: Avoid eager inspect import and use direct class checks for real command modules

asi.hypothesis: Real imported command modules can be scanned via their __dict__ with isinstance(obj, type), avoiding eager inspect import and inspect.getmembers sorting; keep inspect only for test/mock fallback.
asi.result: Small primary improvement driven by dependency/config path; self usecli startup worsened slightly, so monitor future changes.

description: Defer about command metadata/platform/toml imports until invoked

asi.hypothesis: The default about command should be registered at startup but expensive support imports for rendering about output (importlib.metadata, platform, re, tomllib helpers) can wait until the command is actually invoked.
asi.result: Improved dependency startup without changing visible command set; about command behavior remains lazy-correct under tests.

description: Lazy core/ui package exports and config exception import to cut eager startup imports

asi.hypothesis: Importing `usecli.cli.core.base_command` was forcing core/ui package initializers to import error handlers, validators, list rendering, and Rich; lazy package exports plus lazy UsecliConfigError import should avoid that on normal startup.
asi.result: Primary improved; also fixed the circular import introduced by lazy core exports by making ui package exports and manager's config exception import lazy.

description: Lazy import importlib.metadata in ConfigManager

asi.hypothesis: Pure config discovery does not need importlib.metadata on exact local config matches, so defer metadata imports to console-script/package fallback paths.
asi.rollback_reason: Local `import importlib.metadata` inside methods shadowed the global `importlib` package name, causing UnboundLocalError at earlier `importlib.util.find_spec` references.
asi.next_action_hint: Retry using `from importlib import metadata` inside methods (or alias metadata) instead of `import importlib.metadata`.

description: Lazy import importlib.metadata in ConfigManager using metadata alias

asi.hypothesis: Defer importlib.metadata when config lookup finds an exact local usecli.config.toml and does not need package/console-script metadata.
asi.rollback_reason: Checks passed but primary regressed; command_service still imports importlib.metadata for version lookup, and local import overhead may hurt fallback paths.
asi.next_action_hint: If reducing metadata import, target CommandService._load_version or avoid package metadata version lookup in hot paths instead.

description: Move command_service importlib.metadata version imports into _load_version

asi.hypothesis: Most benchmark projects provide a project version, so command_service can avoid importing importlib.metadata at module import time and only load it when package metadata fallback is needed.
asi.rollback_reason: Tests patch `usecli.cli.services.command_service.get_version`; removing the module-level symbol broke those tests.
asi.next_action_hint: Retry with a lightweight module-level `get_version()` wrapper that lazily imports `importlib.metadata.version`, and catch PackageNotFoundError by exception class name to avoid top-level metadata import.

description: Lazy get_version wrapper in command_service to avoid metadata import when project version exists

asi.hypothesis: Keep the test-patchable `get_version` symbol but make it a lazy wrapper so command_service module import avoids importlib.metadata unless package metadata fallback is actually needed.
asi.result: Small primary improvement with checks passing; preserves PackageNotFoundError fallback semantics by detecting the exception class name and re-raising unexpected errors.

description: Lazy Console/Panel creation in about and inspire commands

asi.hypothesis: Default about/inspire commands can register without constructing Rich Console or importing Panel until invoked.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary startup_ms regressed; Rich is already imported by base command/list paths so these lazy object changes do not help startup.
asi.next_action_hint: Target imports that appear in profile before command loading, especially usecli.__init__ top-level list/ui imports, not per-command Console construction.

description: Lazy import list_commands from usecli top-level only when listing/help is needed

asi.hypothesis: Avoid importing UI list rendering during version/normal startup paths by moving list_commands imports into help/listing branches.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary regressed; other imports still pull UI/list or measurement noise dominates, so this local laziness did not improve startup.
asi.next_action_hint: Profile after current kept changes before touching more UI imports; focus on measurable cumulative import chains.

description: Lazy top-level UI exports from usecli module

asi.hypothesis: Project command modules commonly do `from usecli import BaseCommand`; they should not force import of Menu, params, Prompt/Confirm/Console, or console unless those symbols are requested.
asi.result: Large dependency startup improvement. Kept `from usecli import console/Menu/...` compatibility via module `__getattr__`; internal version/error printing now resolves console lazily.

description: Lazy Rich Console proxy in base_command

asi.hypothesis: Command modules import BaseCommand just to subclass/register; that should not require importing rich.console until custom help/group rendering actually prints.
asi.result: Small primary improvement with tests passing; maintained `base_command.console` patch compatibility using a lazy proxy object.

description: Defer title helper import from base_command until help formatting

asi.hypothesis: BaseCommand imports title utilities only to render custom help; normal command registration should not import title.py, importlib.metadata, tomllib, or Rich console.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary regressed significantly despite apparent profile opportunity; likely title import is pulled elsewhere anyway or lazy import changes perturb command registration overhead/noise.
asi.next_action_hint: If revisiting, inspect import graph after change to confirm title.py is actually avoided before benchmarking further.

description: Restrict usecli-only make/init skipping to package command directory

asi.hypothesis: The previous package-command skip should not accidentally skip downstream project commands located in a `make` directory; constrain it to usecli's own package command tree.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary regressed because per-file `path.resolve().is_relative_to(...)` added overhead.
asi.next_action_hint: Retry with a per-directory `is_package_directory = directory.resolve() == package_commands_dir` flag computed once, avoiding per-file resolve while preserving correctness.

description: Constrain usecli-only command skipping with per-directory package flag

asi.hypothesis: Compute whether the scanned directory is usecli's package command directory once, then skip init/make only there so downstream project commands in folders named `make` are still loaded.
asi.rollback_reason: Correctness improved but primary still regressed slightly versus best; need a zero-overhead way to thread package/default command context from load_commands.
asi.next_action_hint: Change `_load_from_dir` to accept `skip_usecli_only: bool = False` and pass it only for package command loading in non-usecli executions; tests patch call counts but should tolerate default parameter.

description: Pass skip_usecli_only flag into package command directory loading

asi.hypothesis: Thread usecli-package context from load_commands to _load_from_dir to avoid per-file path checks and avoid skipping downstream project commands in `make` directories.
asi.rollback_reason: Metric improved, but tests mock `_load_from_dir` with a one-argument side effect and failed on the new keyword argument.
asi.next_action_hint: Retry without changing `_load_from_dir` call signature: set a private instance flag around the package load and have `_load_from_dir` read it, or add a wrapper method for package commands.

description: Scope usecli-only command skipping to package load via private flag

asi.hypothesis: Avoid over-skipping downstream project commands in folders named `make` while preserving the fast path that skips usecli-only init/make package commands for non-usecli executables.
asi.result: Correctness fix for the command discovery constraint with a small primary regression versus the absolute best; kept because the prior optimization could fail to parse everything in a downstream commands folder, which violates the user objective.

description: Hoist skip_usecli_only flag to local in command scan loop

asi.hypothesis: After scoping usecli-only skips via an instance flag, copy it to a local before iterating command files to reduce per-file attribute lookup overhead.
asi.result: Recovered part of the correctness-fix regression while preserving downstream command-folder correctness.

description: Use generator prefilter for usecli-only package commands

asi.hypothesis: Avoid checking skip_usecli_only inside the main command import loop by wrapping package paths in a prefilter generator only when needed.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary regressed slightly; generator overhead outweighed branch removal.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep simple local-flag branch; pursue larger import reductions.

description: Defer shutil import in usecli top-level until version output

asi.hypothesis: `shutil` is only needed for `--version` command path display, so defer it from module import.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary regressed; shutil import is not material or deferred import moved cost into the measured --version path.
asi.next_action_hint: Because benchmark includes --version self path, do not defer imports used by that path unless dependency/config paths benefit enough.

description: Cache parsed usecli.config.toml by mtime/size

asi.hypothesis: Config discovery parses usecli.config.toml for command matching and then parses it again during _load_config; cache by mtime/size to avoid duplicate TOML work in one process.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary regressed slightly; stat/resolve/cache overhead outweighed duplicate parse savings for small config files.
asi.next_action_hint: Avoid duplicate parse with an instance-local handoff from discovery to load rather than a generic global cache, or focus elsewhere.

description: Cache get_config when cwd is unchanged after startup import reductions

asi.hypothesis: Now that command imports are leaner, skipping repeated find_project_root calls for unchanged cwd may help without hurting dependency path.
asi.rollback_reason: Self startup improved dramatically, but primary worsened because config_ms regressed; primary benchmark still prioritizes dependency/config median.
asi.next_action_hint: This remains promising for self CLI startup. Revisit if benchmark weighting changes or combine with config path improvements that offset config_ms regression.

description: Defer theme config loading in colors module until COLOR attribute access

asi.hypothesis: Importing colors.py currently scans config/theme files immediately; initialize COLOR with defaults and load project theme only on first COLOR attribute access.
asi.rollback_reason: Dependency improved slightly but primary regressed due config/self tradeoff and likely delayed theme load in measured self --version path.
asi.next_action_hint: Theme laziness may be useful for command import-only workloads, but current benchmark includes color access; avoid unless paired with cheaper theme_context.

description: Lazy import importlib.metadata in colors config fallback paths

asi.hypothesis: colors.py imports importlib.metadata only for alias/package fallback; exact project config/theme loading should avoid that import.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary regressed; local import overhead/noise offset dependency gain and colors still performs config/theme work.
asi.next_action_hint: Do not micro-optimize colors metadata import alone; any colors improvement needs to reduce actual theme/config search cost.

description: Skip reading packaged default theme TOML when defaults already match constants

asi.hypothesis: The packaged `default.toml` duplicates DEFAULT_THEME_COLORS; when resolving to that package default, avoid opening/parsing the TOML file and use constants directly.
asi.result: Small primary improvement, mostly on dependency path, while still allowing project/default theme overrides because only the package default path is skipped.

description: Avoid resolve() when checking packaged default theme path

asi.hypothesis: THEMES_DIR and resolved theme path should already be comparable, so avoid per-startup resolve() for package default theme skip.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary regressed; path equality without resolve may miss equivalent paths or noise dominated.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep safer resolved comparison from previous kept change.

description: Precompute resolved package default theme path

asi.hypothesis: Avoid constructing/resolving the packaged default theme path on each theme load by precomputing it at module import.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary regressed; moving resolve to import time did not help the measured startup mix.
asi.next_action_hint: Leave package default theme skip as-is; further color changes should reduce config search, not path constants.

description: Use parent-name check for package make command skip

asi.hypothesis: For usecli package commands, make-only modules live directly under a `make` parent directory, so `path.parent.name == "make"` avoids scanning all path parts while preserving scoped project-command correctness.
asi.result: Small primary improvement over current correct implementation.

description: Use parent-name check for internal command skip

asi.hypothesis: Internal command modules currently live directly under an `internal` parent, so parent-name comparison may be cheaper than scanning path.parts.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary regressed; path.parts membership was not a bottleneck or parent access cost/noise offset it.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep only the parent-name optimization for package make skip, which measured better.

description: Use os.path.basename instead of Path for command_name in load_commands

asi.hypothesis: Avoid constructing a Path object just to get argv[0] basename before package command loading.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary regressed; extra os import or noise outweighed any basename savings.
asi.next_action_hint: Do not add imports for tiny path micro-optimizations in command_service.

description: Prefer top-level glob before recursive child scans for command files

asi.hypothesis: Many project commands are flat; scanning top-level *.py first and recursing only into child dirs may reduce Path.rglob overhead while still covering nested commands.
asi.rollback_reason: Tests explicitly expect directory.rglob('*.py') to be called on the provided directory mock; replacing it with glob/iterdir broke mocked behavior.
asi.next_action_hint: Avoid changing _load_from_dir traversal API unless tests are updated; rglob is part of tested behavior.

description: Remove runtime Protocol/final/cast usage from colors module

asi.hypothesis: colors.py startup can be reduced by avoiding Protocol class creation and final/cast runtime helpers used only for typing.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary regressed; typing helper removal did not improve measured import cost and reduces type clarity.
asi.next_action_hint: Leave colors typing structure intact; focus on I/O/config search rather than typing micro-optimizations.

description: Avoid sys.modules registration for dynamically loaded command files

asi.hypothesis: Skipping sys.modules insertion in _import_file reduces dynamic command import overhead.
asi.rollback_reason: Although primary improved, this is a hidden correctness risk: normal import machinery registers modules before exec, and decorators/dataclasses/recursive imports may rely on sys.modules during command module execution.
asi.next_action_hint: If revisiting, investigate safer unique module names or measure whether sys.modules assignment actually matters with dataclass command fixtures before keeping.

description: Restore previous sys.modules entry after command file exec

asi.hypothesis: Preserve normal during-exec sys.modules registration for correctness while avoiding permanent module-name collisions by restoring a previous entry after exec.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary regressed and adds complexity; not a startup win.
asi.next_action_hint: Leave sys.modules behavior unchanged unless addressing a correctness bug separately.

description: Return theme context from _load_theme to avoid duplicate import-time context scan

asi.hypothesis: colors.py calls _load_theme() and then _theme_context() at import, duplicating config/theme discovery; return the context from _load_theme and reuse it.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary regressed; although it removes duplicate-looking work, cache behavior or extra tuple handling did not improve measured startup.
asi.next_action_hint: Profile colors import specifically before restructuring theme context again.

description: Lazy import json for editable direct_url config fallback

asi.hypothesis: ConfigManager imports json only to parse editable-install direct_url.json in rare package fallback paths; defer json from the common config startup path.
asi.result: Small primary improvement, mainly config_ms, with checks passing.

description: Retry lazy importlib.metadata in ConfigManager after other import reductions

asi.hypothesis: With command_service metadata import already lazy, removing ConfigManager's top-level importlib.metadata may now reduce config_ms.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary regressed again; local fallback imports and/or noise offset top-level savings.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep ConfigManager metadata import top-level for now; lazy json was the useful manager import reduction.

description: Use explicit None check after command file import

asi.hypothesis: _import_file returns ModuleType or None; checking `is None` avoids generic truthiness and is semantically tighter in the command loading loop.
asi.result: Small primary improvement with checks passing.

description: Inline real-module command class loop instead of lambda predicate

asi.hypothesis: Avoid per-object lambda calls when scanning real module __dict__ values for BaseCommand subclasses.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary regressed; lambda predicate was not bottleneck or branch duplication hurt instruction/cache behavior.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep existing member loop; focus on larger import/config work.

description: Remove runtime typing import from usecli top-level

asi.hypothesis: With future annotations, Any/Optional/Sequence are not needed at runtime in usecli.__init__, so remove typing import from startup.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary regressed; typing may already be imported by dependencies or noise dominates.
asi.next_action_hint: Avoid tiny typing-import removals unless profile shows they matter.
